anomalies.observed: On the Power sheet, the +12V net is wired to pin 1 of both fan headers J7 and J8, in addition to pin 2.
anomalies.expected: For a standard 4-pin fan header, pin 1 should be GND and pin 2 should be +12V. The specification only identifies J7/J8 pin 2 as the 12 V pin, implying pin 1 is the ground return.

evidence.quote: Power sheet: +12V net connects to J7 pin 1 and J8 pin 1; J7/J8 pin 2 also connects to +12V.
the two fan-header 12 V pins (J7/J8 pin 2)

anomalies.impact: The fans would see +12V on both their power and ground pins, so they would not run. The tachometer signals would also be referenced to +12V instead of GND, potentially damaging the ESP32 inputs.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a fan-header wiring error: pin 1 of J7 and J8 is tied to +12V instead of GND, which would prevent the fans from operating and could damage the tachometer inputs.
